title: Promotion
body:
Syntax: ask <kage> about promotion

Description: Every character starts as a Student. Normal progression: Student -> Genin -> Chunin -> Special Jonin -> Jonin. Jonin is the highest earnable ninja rank; Kage is a separate Implementor-only village appointment, never part of level progression.

Rank caps: Student 10, Genin 35, Chunin 65, Special Jonin 200, Jonin 250. Kage appointment does not change the earned rank or its level cap.

Student -> Genin: at level 10, master the five fundamental skills (Shadow Shuriken Technique, Dynamic Entry, Demonic Illusion: Hell Viewing Technique, Throw Shuriken, Strong Fist Style) to 100%, then find Iruka (VNUM 11) and say Start Genin exam. Pass all 10 questions to earn the Genin headband and 50 mission points.

Genin -> Chunin: at level 35 with 25 completed missions, pass the Forest of Death Chunin Exam ('exam'). Asking the Kage cannot bypass the exam.

Chunin -> Special Jonin: at level 65 with 50 completed missions, ask your village Kage about promotion.

Special Jonin -> Jonin: at level 200 with 100 completed missions, ask your village Kage about promotion.

Jonin can continue gaining levels normally up to 250. No Elite Jonin or Village Elder rank remains. The command PROMOTE advances eligible characters by one normal rank only; it cannot grant Kage.

Kage appointment and removal use SETKAGE, restricted to Implementors. Only one Kage is allowed per village at a time. Removing a Kage appointment leaves the earned ninja rank unchanged. Older Kage saves recover their prior rank (or Jonin if unavailable).

Promotions update the rank headband and announce rank changes globally. Previously introduced rank caps support a one-time legacy safeguard for old character saves; existing level, experience and proficiencies are preserved. Removed historical ranks are converted to Jonin when their saves load.

Date: 2026-11-12
